text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0743, Agreement]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute the Amended Master Cooperative Agreement (MCA) between the City of Los Angeles (City) and the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (LACMTA, collectively ‘the Parties’), which amends the MCA executed in 2023 (Attachment A).
